_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-addons. Merged by the core at load like every engine-surface.<name>.json; readyup_sigcheck / readyup_hookcheck check it with --lib engine2=<libengine2.so>. Ships only with the addons plugin, so a server without it resolves nothing here.

Engine2_SetPendingHostStateRequest.description: CHostStateMgr::SetPendingHostStateRequest(this, CHostStateRequest* request): every map change goes through it. The pending request is at this+0x30; the request is 0x68 bytes with m_Desc +0x10, m_ID +0x1c, m_iMode +0x20, m_Addons (CUtlString) +0x58. readyup-addons appends installed workshop addons to m_Addons so the engine mounts them while it loads the map.
